sloka: अशक्नुवन्तस्ते विष्णुं प्रतियोद्धुं भयार्दिताः ।त्यक्त्वा लङ्कां गता वस्तुं पातालं सहपत्नयः ।। ७.८.२२ ॥
transliteration: aśaknuvantaste viṣṇuṁ pratiyoddhuṁ bhayārditāḥ ।tyaktvā laṅkāṁ gatā vastuṁ pātālaṁ sahapatnayaḥ ।। 7.8.22 ॥

translations.english: Being unable to fight against Vishnu and afflicted by fear, they abandoned Lanka and went to dwell in Pātāla along with their wives.
